description.p: CrunchyVFX designs animated 2D sprite effects for games — explosions, magic, impacts, weather, UI juice — and exports them as sprite sheets, PNG frame sequences, animated PNG or GIF, with trim, pivot and engine metadata for Godot, Unity, Aseprite and Phaser.

Everything is drawn procedurally: 40+ effect systems (shockwaves, lightning, ribbons, vortices, lens flares, weather fields, displacement passes), 80+ hand-drawn particle shapes, 120+ presets, breeding and a Foundry that invents new effects from scratch. Paste a CrunchySFX link and the effect is derived from the sound, with the audio synthesised alongside it and exported beside the sheet.
No sample libraries, no AI models, no cloud, no account. Effects you create are yours to use for anything, commercial or not, with no attribution.
